data.title: Beta Test Officially Ended
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator: 
The Arknights: Endfield Beta Test has officially ended. We thank every Endmini
data.data:
Dear Endministrator:


The Arknights: Endfield Beta Test has officially ended. We thank every Endministrator who took part in or followed this event.


Our official community, survey forms, and customer support received a wealth of opinions and suggestions during the Beta Test. We would also like to take this opportunity to express our gratitude to the Endministrators who experienced the Beta Test and took the initiative to share their feedback with us. The development team shall continue to create new contents, polish existing gameplay systems, and further optimize the Endfield experience. We hope to see you again on a perfected Talos-II.


For more news and updates, please join our official community and follow our official social media. Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
